mascotNote: Cimarron is FSU’s costumed mascot. Osceola and Renegade are its football symbols.
The Tree represents the Stanford Band and serves as Stanford’s unofficial mascot.
Illinois has no official mascot; Chief Illiniwek was retired in 2007.
Michigan has no official mascot. Biff is a historical figure.
Central Michigan uses the Action C logo rather than a mascot.
Hawaiʻi has no official mascot. Vili the Warrior is a former sideline performer.
UNLV has no official mascot. Hey Reb! has been retired.
SDSU has no mascot. The Aztec Warrior was retired as a mascot in 2018.
Louisiana has no current official mascot. Cayenne is a former mascot.
